world.title: First Steps Island
world.subtitle: Bahasa tumbuh dari percakapan kecil.
world.description: Mulai dari lingkungan yang dekat: kenali orang baru, cari jalan di kota, lalu berinteraksi di café.

missions.title: Meet Your New Neighbors
missions.summary: Hari pertama di lingkungan baru. Dua tetangga menyapamu; sekarang giliranmu memperkenalkan diri dan mencari tahu sedikit tentang mereka.
missions.objective: Perkenalkan diri, pahami sapaan sederhana, dan sampaikan informasi singkat tentang dirimu.

steps.label: NOTICE · Vocabulary
steps.prompt: Which word describes someone who lives next door to you?
steps.explanation: A neighbor is someone who lives near you, often in the house next door.

steps.label: LISTEN · A first greeting
steps.audioText: Hello! I'm Maya. I live next door. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you too.
steps.prompt: Who is Maya in this conversation?
steps.explanation: Maya says that she lives next door, so she is a neighbor.

steps.label: READ · A short introduction
steps.passage: Hello, my name is Rafi. I live in the blue house. I am new here. Nice to meet you!
steps.prompt: What does Rafi tell the other person?
options: His name and where he lives
steps.explanation: Rafi introduces himself and says where he lives.

steps.label: NOTICE · Language tool
steps.prompt: Complete the sentence: “I live in ___ small house.”
steps.explanation: Use “a” before a singular countable noun that begins with a consonant sound: a small house.

steps.label: SPEAK · Your turn
steps.prompt: Say two or three sentences to introduce yourself. Include your name and one detail about where you live or what you like.
checklist: I added one detail about myself.
I tried to say the sentences aloud.

steps.label: WRITE · Leave a note
steps.prompt: Write a short introduction for a new neighbor. Aim for two or three simple sentences.
steps.placeholder: Hello, my name is ... I live ...
checklist: I checked capital letters and full stops.

missions.title: A Day Around Town
missions.summary: Kamu punya beberapa urusan di kota kecil ini, tetapi belum mengenal jalannya. Pahami petunjuk arah dan bantu seorang pengunjung menemukan tempat tujuan.
missions.objective: Pahami petunjuk arah sederhana dan jelaskan letak tempat menggunakan ungkapan yang tepat.

steps.label: NOTICE · Vocabulary
steps.prompt: The library is across from the bank. Where is the library?
options: On the opposite side of the bank
steps.explanation: “Across from” means on the opposite side.

steps.label: LISTEN · Follow the directions
steps.audioText: Go straight along this street. Turn left at the corner. The town square is next to the bank.
steps.explanation: The directions say: turn left at the corner.

steps.label: READ · A route note
steps.passage: Start at the bank. Walk straight for one block. Turn left at the corner. The library is across from the park.
steps.explanation: The final sentence places the library across from the park.

steps.label: NOTICE · Language tool
steps.explanation: Use the base verb in an imperative: “Turn left …”

steps.label: SPEAK · Guide a visitor
steps.prompt: Imagine a visitor is standing at the bank. Tell them how to reach the town square. Use at least two direction phrases.
checklist: I used a direction phrase such as “go straight”.
I included a turn or a nearby landmark.
I tried to say the directions aloud.

steps.label: WRITE · A simple route
steps.prompt: Write two or three short instructions that help someone find the library from the bank.
steps.placeholder: Go straight ... Turn ... The library is ...
checklist: My instructions are in a useful order.
I used a direction or place phrase.
Another person could follow the route.

missions.title: A Day at the Café
missions.summary: Setelah berkeliling kota, kamu berhenti di sebuah café kecil. Lihat menu, dengarkan pesanan, lalu sampaikan pesananmu dengan jelas dan sopan.
missions.objective: Pahami menu dan percakapan singkat, lalu pesan makanan atau minuman dengan ungkapan yang sopan.

steps.label: NOTICE · Vocabulary
options: A place where people buy drinks and light meals
A place where people borrow books
steps.explanation: A café is a place that serves drinks and often light meals.

steps.label: READ · Today's menu
steps.passage:
LITTLE CORNER CAFÉ
Coffee — $3
Tea — $2
Bread — $2
Sandwich — $5

Today's note: The café is open until 6 p.m.
steps.prompt: You have $5. Which choice can you order from this menu?
steps.explanation: A sandwich costs $5, so one sandwich fits the budget exactly.

steps.label: LISTEN · At the counter
steps.audioText: Good afternoon. What would you like? I'd like a coffee and a sandwich, please. Certainly. Anything else?
steps.explanation: The customer asks for a coffee and a sandwich.

steps.label: NOTICE · Language tool
steps.prompt: Complete the polite request: “Could I have ___ sandwich, please?”
steps.explanation: “Sandwich” is a singular countable noun and begins with a consonant sound, so use “a”.

steps.label: SPEAK · Place your order
steps.prompt: You are at the café counter. Say what you would like to order and finish with a polite word.
checklist: I named a food or drink.
I tried to say the order aloud.

steps.label: WRITE · An order note
steps.prompt: Write a short order note for the café. Include one drink, one food item, and a polite request.
checklist: I included a drink and a food item.
My request is easy to understand.
I used “please” or another polite expression.
